items.title: NDRRMA Chief Upreti on what Nepal must change after the Bhotekoshi disaster
items.blurb: A month after the Bhotekoshi flood, Nepal’s disaster authorities are assessing the damage, planning reconstruction and considering the relocation of settlements in high-risk areas.

items.title: BP Highway reopens after five-day disruption
items.blurb: Traffic resumed Tuesday morning on an under-construction permanent track after floods damaged the highway at eight locations.

items.title: 12 dead in Baglung floods, landslides over past week
items.blurb: The deaths occurred over several days as incessant rainfall triggered floods and landslides across the district, destroying 51 houses and damaging dozens of others.

items.title: Welcome tourists back—but build resilient systems to keep them safe
items.blurb: The Bhotekoshi flood has once again reminded us that Nepal needs a resilient tourism system to withstand major shocks.

items.title: All three major Nepal-China crossings hit by monsoon disruptions ahead of Dashain
items.blurb: Floods and landslides have halted trade through Rasuwagadhi-Kerung, Tatopani, and Korala border points. Hundreds of containers remain stranded and supplies disrupted ahead of the festive season.

items.title: After the flood, the grey list is now a national emergency
items.blurb: Nepal is about to ask the world for billions, but the world is also asking whether Nepal can keep dirty money out.

items.title: A month in tents, Jajarkot landslide survivors face fresh misery in the rain
items.blurb: Twenty-nine families displaced by a landslide in Bheri-2 have been living under tarpaulins for a month, with continuing rain forcing some to spend nights at a nearby school.

items.title: Four bodies found after Himlung avalanche, 12 still missing
items.blurb: Search teams recovered two more bodies on Monday, while efforts continued to locate 12 workers and guides who have remained unaccounted for since Sunday’s avalanche.

items.title: Flood risk eases, displaced Manang residents return home
items.blurb: Residents who fled to forest shelters after the Marsyangdi river was partially blocked by a landslide on Sunday returned home as the river level fell and the weather cleared.

items.title: Landslide threatens homes in Suryabinayak
items.blurb: The landslide has exposed the foundations of several houses in Hariyali Tole, prompting residents to call for immediate protective measures.

items.title: Rescuers search for 14 missing after Himlung avalanche
items.blurb: A rescue team has reached the base camp, while two bodies recovered from the avalanche are being flown to Kathmandu.
